evidence_quotes.agenda: This is a follow-up inventory-gathering call (customer opted for a phone inventory instead of a virtual walkthrough) — no quid pro quo framing or agenda question either way.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No move-related concern was raised — the customer was budgeting and confirming a repeat customer's prior experience, not raising a worry — scored N/A/full-credit.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'we are time based... let's say I quote you nine hours but the move took five hours, you only pay for five hours' — a clear, explicit 'estimate is a window / pay for actual time' explanation; no rate-lock/100k line, no explicit self-prep tip, no fairness check, and the estimate/close never happened live on this call (deferred to email).

top_strength: Clearly and reassuringly explained the time-based billing model with a concrete example (quoted 9 hours, only pay for 5 if that's the actual time) to a repeat customer who remembered being over-charged before.
coaching_note: The full differentiator block (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time/Communication) and the personalized estimate were never delivered live — everything was deferred to a follow-up email/text, missing the chance to build trust in real time.
